embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: Cube-Splat: High-Fidelity 360° Gaussian Splatting SLAM via Cubemap Factorization and Adjoint-Consistent Pose Tracking
fields.value: Ant Group; other authors are Zhejiang University only); kept and flagged per policy) (flag) — The paper presents Cube-Splat, a 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM system for 360° panoramic cameras, built to overcome the limited field of view of pinhole-camera SLAM pipelines that increases drift in large scenes.

fields.name: ConsistWorld: Evidence Routing for Consistent Multi-Agent World Models
fields.value: StepFun (flag) — ConsistWorld is a multi-agent video world model that generates camera-controlled video streams of a static scene from a single shared source image, with multiple independently steered "agents" (viewpoints) exploring the same world.

fields.name: Uncertainty-Aware RL-Controlled Adaptive 3D Mapping
fields.value: Microsoft — The paper (project name "UnRL") proposes an adaptive 3D voxel mapping framework that refines voxel resolution based on semantic entropy, geometric curvature, and texture richness, paired with a reinforcement-learning agent that learns voxel-subdivision policies under a user-specified memory budget.

fields.name: SplashSplat: Reconstructing Splashing Liquids from Real-World Multi-View Videos
fields.value: Google; Marc Pollefeys and Daniel Barath list ETH Zurich/EPFL) — The paper presents SplashSplat, a method for reconstructing dynamic, splashing liquids (from coherent streams to violent splashes) from real-world multi-view video, plus a new 20-scene benchmark captured with seven synchronized 4K cameras at 60 fps.

fields.name: PART: Learning 3D Part Assembly and Retrieval with Transformers
fields.value: Tencent — The paper presents PART, a unified transformer-based framework that reconstructs target 3D shapes by retrieving appropriate parts from a library and predicting their 6-DoF poses.

fields.name: LYRIC: Language-Driven Physics-Based Character Control for Contact-Rich Whole-Body Object Interaction
fields.value: Sony; other authors (Zeyu Han, Zichong Meng, Huaizu Jiang) list Northeastern University — LYRIC is a generative flow-matching controller that lets physics-simulated humanoid characters perform contact-rich, whole-body object interactions (manipulation combined with locomotion) from a free-form language instruction and a sparse terminal object goal.

fields.name: PointZero: 3D Point Track Completion for Learning Transferable 3D Dynamics
fields.value: NVIDIA — The paper studies "3D point track completion" — predicting future 3D trajectories of all observed points from a single RGB-D frame plus sparse partial 3D tracks — as a pre-training objective for learning 3D dynamics without robot action labels.

fields.name: Can MiniMax-H3 Reason About the Physical World? An Evaluation of Omni-Modal Generative Models
fields.value: Tencent — The paper introduces an evaluation framework that tests whether the omni-modal generative model MiniMax-H3 can integrate complementary evidence spread across text, image, video, and audio modalities to reason about physical-world dynamics.
